policy.tiny_values: For nonzero reference magnitude below 1e-8, relative tolerance only; exact zero uses absolute tolerance.
policy.scientific_summary: Exact fields, schema, counts and strings; numeric maxima use the unchanged relative/absolute arcsec criteria. Exact numeric equality reported separately.

policy.scope: One provenance-only derivative of historical arithmetic, not new measurements, original historical author code, or a new physical validation.
policy.stop: Any discrepancy stays failed: no numerical retry, source tuning, or tolerance relaxation.

environment.scope: Python audit events; inspected code contains no native network/GPU path. Not an OS firewall or packet capture.

astropy_crosscheck_public.scope: Python audit events; inspected code contains no native network/GPU path. Not an OS firewall or packet capture.
